AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Personal Hygiene? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Personal Hygiene.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Personal Hygiene.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Personal Hygiene.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Personal Hygiene.

3. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Growing Fruits? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Growing Fruits.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Growing Fruits.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Growing Fruits.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Growing Fruits.

5. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. watt (W)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. joule (J)

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Domestic Hygiene? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Domestic Hygiene.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Domestic Hygiene.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Domestic Hygiene.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Domestic Hygiene.

8. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

9. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 100 °C

10. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Only carbon dioxide

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fuel Conservation? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fuel Conservation.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fuel Conservation.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Fuel Conservation.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fuel Conservation.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Balanced Meal? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Balanced Meal.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Balanced Meal.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Balanced Meal.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Balanced Meal.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Personal Hygiene and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Domestic Hygiene and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Making Tacking Stitches and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

3. D — Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

4. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Growing Fruits.

6. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds.

7. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Domestic Hygiene.

8. D — Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

9. D — 100 °C

10. B — Glucose and oxygen

11. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fuel Conservation.

12. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Balanced Meal.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Personal Hygiene; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
